mapper.sql: r.id AS relationId, r.flash_promotion_id AS flashPromotionId, r.flash_promotion_session_id AS flashPromotionSessionId, r.product_id AS productId, r.product_sku_id AS productSkuId, r.flash_promotion_price AS flashPromotionPrice, r.flash_promotion_count AS flashPromotionCount, r.flash_promotion_limit AS flashPromotionLimit, p.title AS flashPromotionTitle, DATE_FORMAT(s.start_time, '%H:%i:%s') AS sessionStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(s.end_time, '%H:%i:%s') AS sessionEndTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_flash_promotion_record (relation_id, member_id, product_id, product_sku_id, quantity, status, create_time) VALUES (#{relationId}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productSkuId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sms_flash_promotion_record WHERE relation_id = #{relationId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM sms_flash_promotion_record WHERE relation_id = #{relationId} AND status IN (0, 10, 1, 4)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sms_flash_promotion_record WHERE relation_id = #{relationId} AND status IN (0, 10, 1, 4)
SELECT member_id FROM sms_flash_promotion_record WHERE relation_id = #{relationId} AND status IN (0, 10, 1, 4)
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_flash_promotion_record SET status = 0, error_msg = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, create_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r LEFT JOIN sms_flash_promotion p ON r.flash_promotion_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sms_flash_promotion_session s ON r.flash_promotion_session_id = s.id WHERE r.id = #{relationId}

SELECT
FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r LEFT JOIN sms_flash_promotion p ON r.flash_promotion_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sms_flash_promotion_session s ON r.flash_promotion_session_id = s.id WHERE r.flash_promotion_id = #{flashPromotionId} AND r.flash_promotion_session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY r.sort ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT
FROM sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r INNER JOIN sms_flash_promotion p ON r.flash_promotion_id = p.id INNER JOIN sms_flash_promotion_session s ON r.flash_promotion_session_id = s.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND s.status = 1 AND p.start_date <= #{currentDate} AND p.end_date >= #{currentDate} AND ( (s.start_time <= s.end_time AND #{currentTime} >= s.start_time AND #{currentTime} <= s.end_time) OR (s.start_time > s.end_time AND (#{currentTime} >= s.start_time OR #{currentTime} <= s.end_time)) ) ORDER BY r.id ASC
